outcome: perceived control over labor (measured by Labour Agentry Scale)
cohort: Postpartum patients who delivered at term (37-41 weeks gestation)
finding: There was no significant difference in perceived control over labor between women with BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2 and those with BMI < 30 kg/m2 after adjusting for length of labor and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Women with BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2 initially had lower perceived control over labor, but this difference became non-significant after adjusting for length of labor and cesarean birth.
